[PREFERENCE] User wants to apply Agile principles to their team project.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Congratulations on attending the project management workshop!  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended project management tools include: Jira, Trello, Asana, Microsoft Azure DevOps, Wrike, Smartsheet, Monday.com, and Podio.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jira offers features like sprint planning, Kanban boards, burndown charts, and customizable workflows.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Trello is ideal for Kanban-style project management and offers features like power-ups, integrations, and automation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Asana helps teams stay organized with workflows, custom fields, and reporting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Microsoft Azure DevOps combines project management, version control, and continuous integration and delivery.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Wrike offers Gantt charts, custom workflows, and resource allocation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Smartsheet integrates with Google Sheets and Excel and offers Gantt charts and Kanban boards.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Monday.com is customizable and offers Kanban boards, Gantt charts, and automated workflows.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Podio offers customizable workflows and integrates with many third-party tools.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Factors to consider when choosing a tool include scalability, customization, integration, user adoption, and cost.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested taking advantage of free trials or demos to test tools.  
[USER] User is considering using Jira for their project.  
[USER] User is unsure if Jira is suitable for a team of 5 people.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jira is suitable for teams of all sizes, including small teams.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jira's scalability features include flexible workflows, multi-project management, user management, and integration with other Atlassian tools.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jira offers a free plan for up to 10 users, a Standard plan at $7 per user/month, and a Premium plan at $14 per user/month.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Standard plan includes advanced roadmaps, custom fields, and automation rules.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For a team of 5, the Standard plan would cost $35 per month (billed annually).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Atlassian offers discounts for annual billing, education and non-profit organizations, and startups.  
[USER] User is considering the free plan but is worried about limitations.
